plan.reason: The comment presents a false dilemma by implying only two options, yet all three reviewers agree on this classification. There is no clear polarization or inconsistency that warrants cross‑examination or point‑counterpoint. A round‑robin discussion lets each reviewer cast their judgment in turn without further adjudication.

Factual.content: The comment presents only two extremes—“elect evil and allow rights elimination” versus “vote for Carlos and guarantee equal rights”—implying no other options exist. This creates a false dilemma by forcing a choice between two mutually exclusive and exhaustive alternatives when, in reality, more options could exist.

Logical.content: Obviously, we elect evil and allow Fabricio to eliminate the rights of those he does not agree with or we vote for Carlos and guarantee equal rights for all. Or are there more options for election? Is there anyone who is more moderate on all issues? (supports the inference that only two candidate options exist: Fabricio = evil or Carlos = promising equal rights).
